summary: The candidate's recycled ReplaySSM ping-pong cursor reset is verified failing-before/passing-after and on a real gfx950 device, but the original shared-prefix serving/cache-reuse and TTFT contract could not be exercised without the reported hybrid model weights and H200/CUDA environment.

tests.what_was_measured: Failing-before: both cursor-reset assertions failed; the two new guard tests also failed earlier because the base lacks the candidate helper. Overall 4 failed, 1 passed.
Candidate regression: allocation reset, donation replacement reset, non-ReplaySSM behavior, GDN admission, and KDA rejection; 5 passed.

tests.command: PYTHONPATH=/job/repo/python /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-948a9e59f8af/venv/bin/python -m pytest -q test/registered/unit/mem_cache/test_unified_radix_cache_unittest.py -k 'mamba and (extra_buffer or cache_finished or cache_unfinished)'
tests.what_was_measured: Nearby unified radix/Mamba cache behavior; 27 passed, 3 skipped, 2542 deselected.

tests.command: PYTHONPATH=/job/repo/python ROCR_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-948a9e59f8af/venv/bin/python < independent GPU slot-ownership fixture
tests.what_was_measured: On AMD Instinct MI355X gfx950, lazy slot 5 and tensor-installed slot 6 had stale cursors reset to zero. A tensor-valued -1 sentinel also unexpectedly cleared the last cursor element.

gpu_execution.evidence: Independent cursor ownership operations executed and synchronized on AMD Instinct MI355X, gfx950:sramecc+:xnack-. No model/kernel serving workload was run.

remaining_counterexamples: No repeated-shared-prompt serving run proves cached_tokens becomes nonzero with ReplaySSM plus extra_buffer.
No end-to-end numerical check proves a GDN force-flushed donated checkpoint reconstructs the same state as recurrent execution.
A tensor-valued -1 passed to set_mamba_ping_pong_slot clears replayssm_write_pos[-1], although current clear callers use an integer sentinel.
remaining_limitations: The assigned architecture is AMD MI355X gfx950/ROCm 7.2, not NVIDIA H200/CUDA from the report.
Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B weights were unavailable, so prefix hit rate, cached_tokens, TTFT, E2E latency, throughput, and semantic accuracy were not measured.
The candidate changes Python only; no native C++ or FlyDSL source changed, so a native rebuild was not applicable.
Legacy MambaRadixCache and multi-node/TP configurations were not exercised.
